mappings.reason: Awarded for stating force proportional to product of masses and inverse square of separation between point masses, directly covered by Newton's law of gravitation lesson.
Awarded for equating gravitational force to centripetal acceleration for circular orbit and deriving rho-T relation, directly covered by analyse circular orbits lesson.
Awarded for numerical use of gravitational circular-orbit relation rho T^2 = 3 pi n^3 / G to calculate mean density.
Awarded for inferring Jupiter is gas/liquid from low density vs rock; no supplied lesson covers planetary composition inference.
Awarded for defining specific latent heat as (thermal) energy per unit mass for change of state, directly covered by define and use specific latent heat.
Awarded for work done on/against atmosphere (W=pΔV) and increase in internal energy/potential energy accounted via first law, covered by work at constant pressure and first law lesson.
Awarded for using electrical energy minus loss = M*L to calculate specific latent heat of vaporisation, directly covered by define and use specific latent heat.
Awarded for defining radian as angle subtended at centre by arc equal to radius.
Awarded for angular frequency = 2pi x frequency in SHM context, covered by displacement/amplitude/period/frequency/angular frequency terms.
Awarded for recognising a proportional to -x with constant c/ML3, i.e. SHM condition acceleration proportional opposite to displacement.
Awarded for equating c/ML3 to (2pi f)2 via a = -w2 x to calculate c.
Part (a) awards generation of ultrasound for diagnosis - piezo-electric crystal/transducer vibration/resonance covered by piezo-electric generation/detection lesson.

Part (b) awards advantage of high-frequency (better resolution/detail of internal structures) - maps to reflection at boundaries for diagnostic information lesson; no other supplied lesson covers frequency-dependent imaging benefit.
Awarded knowledge is ADC sampling at 5.0kHz and 4-bit quantisation (8.0mV->1000, 5.8mV->0101). No supplied lesson covers sampling, quantisation or digital transmission.
Awarded knowledge is DAC reconstruction as stepped levels at 0.2ms intervals with correct levels. No supplied lesson covers DAC output or signal reconstruction.
Awarded knowledge is effect of more bits giving smaller step heights and more accurate reproduction. No supplied lesson covers bit depth / quantisation accuracy.
Awarded for radial field lines appearing to originate from centre, directly matching lesson on charge outside spherical conductor acting as point charge at centre.
Awarded for E from V-x gradient / E=V/x, matching electric field equals negative potential gradient.
Awarded for R where V becomes constant / field zero inside conductor, i.e. zero potential gradient inside.
Awarded knowledge is definition of feedback in amplifier/op-amp circuits; no supplied lesson covers op-amps or feedback (supplied lessons are t12-t25: circular motion to astronomy).
Awarded knowledge is benefits of negative feedback (stability, bandwidth, distortion); no supplied lesson covers amplifier feedback.
Awarded knowledge is non-inverting op-amp gain calculation gain=Vout/Vin and gain=1+Rf/R; no supplied lesson covers op-amp circuits.
Awarded knowledge is op-amp saturation when output would exceed supply voltage; no supplied lesson covers saturation/op-amps.
Names faces across which Hall voltage appears, covered by origin of Hall voltage lesson.
Explains magnetic deflection, charge build-up and balancing electric field giving constant VH, the origin of Hall voltage.
Compares VH for metal vs semiconductor via VH=BI/ntq, inversely proportional to carrier number density n.
Awarded knowledge is generic definition of field of force as region where particle experiences force. Lesson covers magnetic field as example of a field of force.
Awarded points describe crossed E and B fields normal to velocity with opposite equal forces for velocity selection, directly matching lesson on velocity selection.
Undeviated path Q for 2q at same v tests that velocity-selection condition remains satisfied when both electric and magnetic forces scale with charge.
Deviated path V for larger v tests loss of force balance in velocity selector, with magnetic deflection dominating.
Sketch of E_MAX vs lambda requires hf=Phi+KE and threshold wavelength where E_MAX=0.
Sketch of de Broglie wavelength vs momentum requires lambda=h/p.
Awarded for identifying conducting diodes in four-diode bridge for full-wave rectification.
Awarded for polarity of bridge-rectifier output, part of full-wave bridge operation.
Awarded for Vrms = V0/sqrt2 from sinusoidal input.
Awarded for extracting frequency from V=5.6 sin380t via 380=2pi f and doubling for full-wave peaks.
Awarded for sketching smoothed output with capacitor reducing ripple to 1.6V.
Awarded for higher mean/r.m.s. p.d. with smoothing giving increased mean power in resistor.
Awarded for spontaneous/random emission from unstable nucleus, covered by random/spontaneous decay lesson.
Awarded for defining decay constant as probability/fraction per unit time, directly taught in activity and decay constant lesson.
Awarded for energy sharing with antineutrino; no supplied lesson covers beta energy spectrum/antineutrino.
Awarded for N from mass and A=lambda N calculation.
Awarded for exponential decay 1/50=exp(-lambda t) to find t, covered by exponential decay lesson.
